# Fernbank vendor contacts

Support for Fernbank comes through the Lakes Consortium help desk, not from the vendor directly. Open a ticket for outages, login trouble, or record display problems. Urgent outages during open hours can go to the consortium's on-call phone, which is posted in every branch workroom.

[[Odile Varga]] and Teodor Quist are the only staff who can open tickets about record loads. See [[Project Kestrel#Owners]] for who handled what during the move.
